selected_direction.hypothesis: The random-street ensemble changes the ensemble mean largest-SCC fraction relative to alternating Manhattan streets at matched sizes. Independently sample a fair direction for each whole row and column, hold orientations fixed throughout each realization, and share occupation uniforms on corresponding geometric bonds between arms. Use probabilities [0,0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45,0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.7,0.75,0.8,0.85,0.9,0.95,1] in every parameter object, including sanity. Measure largest-SCC size divided by L^2 at each probability. Each arm returns its own direct endpoint; paired differences and uncertainty are evaluated afterward. An unresolved contrast is inconclusive. Any follow-up retains identical fixed sizes in both arms and can use an approved larger replicate count. This tests finite-size connectivity, not universality or critical exponents.

selected_direction.hypothesis: Expanding the screening field to account for prescribed cross-track uncertainty will reduce missed actual crossings relative to nominal-field screening, while increasing false alerts. Compare identical synthetic circular trajectories and perturbed realizations across field sizes and ranges. Measure missed crossings divided by all actual crossings, and false alerts divided by all alerts; report undefined ratios when denominators vanish. Include predicted near misses that perturb into the field. Test bounded offsets first; only interpret probabilities after explicitly specifying an assumed error distribution. The hypothesis is unsupported if missed-crossing rates do not decrease. This concerns orbital uncertainty, not search-cadence accuracy.

next_decision.result_interpretation: Partial global padding recovered most missed crossings but increased alert burden in every paired seed. Mean FN/(TP+FN) fell from 0.11618 to 0.01180; the treatment-minus-control interval [-0.12560, -0.08316] exceeds the preregistered 0.02 improvement criterion in magnitude, subject to exploratory inference. Across the four seeds, remaining misses were 10, 5, 4 and 9; additional false alerts were 191, 180, 206 and 191. FP/(TP+FP) increased in every pair, from 0.111–0.142 to 0.291–0.325. This shifts the next question toward whether altitude-specific padding preserves useful recovery with less alert burden. It does not establish that altitude-specific padding is better.
